- https://coinmarketcap.com/view/stablecoin/

issue_context.title: Add missing stable coins for currency conversions
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
backtesting  binance  cypto  

#### Actual Behavior
Can't place an order

#### Potential Solution
- Add all crypto exchanges missing stable coins to be added at https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Common/Currencies.cs#L116

#### Reproducing the Problem
 def Initialize(self):  
    self.SetStartDate(2018, 5, 2)  
    self.SetEndDate(2021, 5, 4)  
    self.SetCash("USDT",200000, Decimal(1))            
    self.SetBrokerageModel(BrokerageName.Binance, AccountType.Cash)

    self.btcusdtSymbol = self.AddCrypto("BTCUSDT", Resolution.Hour, Market.Binance).Symbol


def OnData(self, data):
     if self.Time.hour <= 5: 
        self.SetHoldings("BTCUSDT", 1)

     elif self.Time.hour > 5: 
         self.Buy("BTCUSDT", 1)
